prompt: A sun-drenched backyard garden is depicted in this photorealistic photo, featuring lush greenery and vibrant flowers. In the center foreground, a gardener in muddy boots kneels on the grass, planting a small sapling into the soil. To the left, a young girl in a yellow dress waters nearby rose bushes with a red watering can, her attention focused on the blooms. On the right, an older man in a straw hat sits on a stone bench, reading a newspaper while a tabby cat rests on his lap. Behind them, a clothesline stretches across the yard, holding several drying shirts that flutter gently in the breeze. A bicycle leans against a wooden fence in the background, partially obscured by climbing ivy. In the immediate foreground, a wicker basket filled with freshly picked vegetables sits on the grass next to a pair of gardening gloves. A bee hovers near a sunflower on the left side of the frame. The sunlight filters through the leaves of a large maple tree, casting dappled shadows on the ground and highlighting the rich textures of the soil, petals, and fabric, creating a serene and productive domestic scene.
